variants.bio: Tails Doll is a doll that resembles Tails, enough to be considered an eerie insult to him. Being created as another attempt to catch Sonic. He appears in Sonic R, being unlockable after obtaining 5 Sonic Tokens in Radical City, placing first in the same race, and then beating Tails Doll in the ensuing unlock race. He's also appeared in other games, being shown as a creepy doll, in an attempt to catch Sonic off guard.
